high_level_description: American traditional tattoo flash of a tiger head on plain white, thick black outlines and a limited palette, presented flat and front-on as a single centred flash design, centered symmetrical composition, one design centred with a generous plain white margin on all sides.

style_description.aesthetics: old school tattoo parlour flash sheet, confident heavy line work
style_description.lighting: flat even, none, flat, neutral white balance, true tones
style_description.art_style: medium shot, waist up, shot at eye level, neutral perspective, 50mm lens, true-to-eye perspective, f8, graphic

compositional_deconstruction.background: plain flat white, nothing else, no skin, no arm, no paper texture

elements.desc: a snarling tiger head drawn as American traditional tattoo flash, very thick even black outlines, bold black whisker and fur strokes, flat red and gold fill, heavy black shading blocks
